offers_products.reason: Sells insurance policies, which count as services; no goods or software among main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Specialty commercial property and casualty insurance counts as a service; insurers are classed as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Focuses on specialized commercial insurance products for businesses, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Specialty commercial P&C coverages sold to businesses, plus public sector and financial institution divisions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Insurance policies renew regularly, giving ongoing premium revenue from repeat commercial customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Commercial insurance is needed and often required; customers rarely drop coverage in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Insurance premiums are routine recurring payments, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for risk-bearing and balance-sheet capacity, not mainly staff time; insurer, not a labor service.

large_customers.reason: Specialty commercial coverage serves many small and mid-sized businesses via brokers; not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Insurer needs capital and investments, not plants, fleets or networks; it is selling its resort.
